title: NASP as cover program for Aurora

tellings.quote: And Bill became convinced that NASP was actually a cover program for Aurora.

plain: NASP, a US programme of the 1980s to build a plane that could fly from runway to space, is said to have been a cover for Aurora, a secret spy plane rumoured at the time. The writer Nick Cook tells Michels that a fellow aviation writer named Bill Sweetman became convinced of this. If so, a public programme would have hidden a secret aircraft behind it.
